raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Add a `push` input (boolean, default `true`) to the ROCm7.2, ROCm 10 and gfx1151 nightly image workflows. When a manual dispatch sets `push=false`, the image is built but every `docker push`, the lmsys retag/push, and the image-tag artifact are skipped.

## Why

Every AMD image workflow ends in `docker push`, and there's no other way to build the ROCm image on the `amd-docker-scale` runners. So a Dockerfile fix can't be checked before merge without publishing the branch build as `rocm/sgl-dev:v<ver>-<rocm>-<arch>-<DATE>` and `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:<same>`. That is the same tag the nightly uses for that day.

## Notes for the reviewer

- `PUSH_IMAGES` is `github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.push`, so scheduled runs always push, and so does a dispatch that leaves the input at its default. Nightly behavior doesn't change.
- The Docker Hub logins for pulling are kept, so build-only runs still pull base images authenticated.
- The two Miles workflows aren't touched because they build from `radixark/miles`.

## Test plan

Build-only dispatches from this branch, both with `push=false`, both passed:
- gfx1151: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39841576697
- ROCm7.2, `gfx942-rocm720` only: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39841585351. The full build completed and logged `Build-only run: not pushing rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi30x-20261022`. The artifact and lmsys login/push steps were skipped.

Neither log has any `docker push` output. ROCm 10 uses the same guard but hasn't been dispatched.

---

<!-- pr-states:end -->

@@ -2,10 +2,20 @@ name: Release Docker Images Nightly gfx1151 (AMD)
 
 on:
   workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      push:
+        description: "Push the image to Docker Hub (uncheck to only check that the branch builds)"
+        required: false
+        type: boolean
+        default: true
   schedule:
     # Stagger this build from the CDNA ROCm nightlies at 12:00 UTC.
     - cron: "0 14 * * *"
 
+# Scheduled runs always push; a manual dispatch can turn the push off.
+env:
+  PUSH_IMAGES: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.push }}
+
 concurrency:
   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
   cancel-in-progress: true
@@ -59,5 +69,9 @@ jobs:
             --no-cache \
             --progress=plain \
             -t "rocm/sgl-dev:${IMAGE_TAG}"
-          docker push "rocm/sgl-dev:${IMAGE_TAG}"
-          echo "Published rocm/sgl-dev:${IMAGE_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          if [ "${PUSH_IMAGES}" = "true" ]; then
+            docker push "rocm/sgl-dev:${IMAGE_TAG}"
+            echo "Published rocm/sgl-dev:${IMAGE_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          else
+            echo "Build-only run: not pushing rocm/sgl-dev:${IMAGE_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          fi

@@ -21,9 +21,18 @@ on:
           - 'all'

   schedule:

+# Scheduled runs always push; a manual dispatch can turn the push off.
+env:

+
 concurrency:
   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.number || github.sha }}
   cancel-in-progress: true
@@ -106,15 +115,21 @@ jobs:

@@ -112,31 +121,39 @@ jobs:
           # UBUNTU_MIRROR forces apt over HTTPS to dodge port-80 reachability flakes
           # to Canonical's archive.ubuntu.com mirror IPs from the amd-docker-scale runner.
           docker build . -f docker/rocm.Dockerfile --build-arg SGL_BRANCH=${{ github.ref_name }} --build-arg BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} --build-arg GPU_ARCH=${{ matrix.gpu_arch }} --build-arg ENABLE_MORI=1 --build-arg ENABLE_NIXL=1 --build-arg SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=${pretend_version} --build-arg UBUNTU_MIRROR=https://archive.ubuntu.com -t rocm/sgl-dev:${tag}-${{ env.DATE }} --no-cache
-          docker push rocm/sgl-dev:${tag}-${{ env.DATE }}
+          if [ "${PUSH_IMAGES}" = "true" ]; then
+            docker push rocm/sgl-dev:${tag}-${{ env.DATE }}
+          else
+            echo "Build-only run: not pushing rocm/sgl-dev:${tag}-${{ env.DATE }}"
+          fi
 
       # Persist the tag right after rocm/sgl-dev push succeeds so the local
       # registry mirror can run even if a later step in this job (lmsys push)
       # fails. By default this step only runs when the previous step succeeded,
       # so the artifact only exists when an image actually landed on Docker Hub.
       - name: Save published image tag
+        if: env.PUSH_IMAGES == 'true'
         run: |
           mkdir -p image-tag
           echo "${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}" > "image-tag/${{ matrix.gpu_arch }}.txt"
 
       - name: Upload image tag artifact
+        if: env.PUSH_IMAGES == 'true'
         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
         with:
           name: image-tag-${{ matrix.gpu_arch }}
           path: image-tag/${{ matrix.gpu_arch }}.txt
           retention-days: 1
 
       - name: Login to Docker Hub (lmsys)
+        if: env.PUSH_IMAGES == 'true'
         uses: docker/login-action@v2
         with:
           username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
           password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
 
       - name: Push to lmsysorg/sglang-rocm
+        if: env.PUSH_IMAGES == 'true'
         run: |
           docker tag rocm/sgl-dev:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }} lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
           docker push lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
